svg.aria-label: AB763 Super Reverb-style · eyelet board layout (derived) — redrawn board layout diagram
svg.text: AB763 Super Reverb-style · eyelet board layout (derived)

Redrawn from Fender 'SUPER-REVERB-AMP AB763' schematic (drawing code C-FD, cited in this circuit's sources) — layout DERIVED from that circuit drawing; no factory board-layout sheet for this circuit was located — not a trace

Heater layer: this drawing establishes its 5 V circuit against the amplifier's own sheet; the rest of the heater wiring it does not. There is no factory board-layout drawing for the rest to be read off. At the centre-tapped valves (V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6) it shows the two heater pins

on opposite supply legs — the 12.6 V series arrangement; a 6.3 V supply straps them into one leg and returns on the centre tap. The valves on the chain are this circuit's own; the order the chain reaches them in is this drawing's convention.
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
6.3 V heaters — twisted pair (leg grouping not established)
